run_inpaint_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionInpaintPipelineLegacy to inpaint masked regions of an image guided by a text prompt
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
preprocess_image: preprocess a PIL image by resizing to multiple of 8 and normalizing to a torch tensor
preprocess_mask: preprocess a mask image or tensor by resizing, normalizing, and inverting for latent-space inpainting
prepare_latents: prepare initial latents by encoding an image through the VAE and adding noise at a given timestep
